node.title: Coste de claridad
node.summary: Producing decision-ready clarity uses time, effort and operational capacity.

relations: The calibration example makes the minimum-information problem concrete: an application inventory alone may not reveal what would be lost.
El caso no cuantifica un umbral mínimo universal. Una revisión acotada puede omitir dependencias no conocidas, que deben permanecer explícitas.
The cost and disruption of validating assumptions can be made explicit within a reframing mandate.
Medir el coste de descubrir no demuestra el valor causal de un marco alternativo. Los criterios de salida deben fijarse antes de conocer los resultados.
A bounded diagnostic could test when additional determination still has material decision value before the intervention window closes.
La suficiencia de información no se reduce a coste esperado: restricciones de seguridad, sesgo y derechos pueden exigir una fuente aunque no cambie la opción preferida.
Regional fragmentation suggests a testable question: does answering the same capability-continuity question become more costly as dependencies multiply?
Entrelazamiento y coste pueden compartir causas; una correlación de inventarios no demostraría causalidad.
Coordination overhead can be examined through the time and disturbance required to answer a fixed operational question across handoffs.
No toda coordinación es desperdicio; mantener fija la calidad y el alcance de la respuesta que se compara.
The minimum information for an architecture decision may include an operator's situated judgment, making its acquisition a real project cost.
El mínimo depende de la decisión, y la observación puede alterar la práctica que intenta describir.
Maintained operational tracking could lower the cost of answering selected questions, provided its own maintenance burden is counted.
El seguimiento puede generar su propia carga y no elimina decisiones aún no constituidas.
The cost of obtaining clarity and the contribution of the capability being examined require separate measures and independent interpretations.
No usar resistencia a una entrevista, coste de mapeo o miedo a apagar como sustitutos de valor probado.
Unpriced clarity may consume human effort, but only the task-level distinction between necessary work and fixable compensation can classify that effort as debt.
No convertir todas las reuniones, auditorías o decisiones de gobierno en HID; parte puede ser NEO o GIC.
The capture-to-architecture step helps target the minimum information needed for a decision rather than treating complete documentation as the prerequisite for all action.
No se elimina la investigación ni se afirma que cualquier muestreo pequeño baste para toda la empresa.
The GEPLAN field account illustrates how incident investigation exposed the operational information that implementation initially lacked.
La lectura retrospectiva no demuestra que el protocolo Cost of Clarity se utilizara entonces ni cuantifica su coste.
The agreement-load model offers a local test of rising clarity cost, provided the actual sign-off topology is measured rather than assumed to require full pairwise consensus.
La combinatoria del modelo no demuestra una ley empírica universal ni cubre por sí sola el coste total de claridad.
Qualified reuse can reduce the cost of clarity only after source production, discovery, integration, per-use verification and renewal costs are counted.
El criterio algebraico identifica una clase posible; no demuestra ahorro neto ni descubrimiento barato en campo.
The human cost of clarity includes keeping intervention capacity available, maintaining it and qualifying alternative information routes, not only time spent on a case.
La clasificación es propuesta para instrumentación; no constituye una cifra HID o un coste medido.
A cost-of-clarity comparison should expose its price and precision assumptions and retain the regions where directed evidence or a conventional route is preferable.
Los cruces son consecuencias del contrato sintético, no una ley de costes observada en mercados.
Compare evidence precision and provenance before pricing the procedures; a favorable price assumption must not be reported as an architectural advantage.
Es un control de diseño experimental con una pregunta finita; no una estimación general del valor de información empresarial.
